hints.title: Top-Three Column Selection
hints.text: Because only three rooks are placed, at most two other rooks can conflict with any chosen column. Therefore, keeping the top three values in each row guarantees finding an optimal conflict-free candidate.

hints.title: Row Triplet Combination
hints.text: For each row, extract its three largest values with column indices.

hints.title: Exhaustive Conflict-Free Search
hints.text: Iterate through all unique combinations of three rows and combine their top-three entries, discarding choices with matching column indices.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting each row takes O(m * n log n), and combining top 3 elements takes 27 * C(m, 3).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all (m*n)^3 rook triplets takes unacceptable execution time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) memory stores top three cells per row.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that maintaining only top 3 candidates per row avoids column collision bottlenecks.
